title: IMSCC Packaging Report
description: W3.H sub-task H3: per-build sidecar emitted by `Courseforge/scripts/packaging/package_multifile_imscc.py::package_imscc` next to the IMSCC archive (default `<project_root>/05_final_package/packaging_report.json`). Records pages_authored vs pages_packaged plus the per-reason exclusion histogram so the W3.G master promotion-chain aggregator can attribute every dropped page. Optional artifact — absence is interpreted as a legacy build (pre-W3.H) by the master aggregator.

schema_version.description: Schema-contract version. Bumped only when the emit shape changes.

course_code.description: Canonical course code (`COURSE_NAME`-style identifier passed into the packager).

course_title.description: Human-readable course title (best-effort — derived from project_config.json upstream).

package_path.description: Absolute path to the emitted `.imscc` archive.

outline_only.description: True when the build was packaged with `--outline-only` (drops content/example/assessment pages from the zip). Lets the master aggregator tell intentional outline pruning from quality failures.

source_coverage.description: Canonical W3.H source_coverage block. Drop reason codes for the H3 packaging arrow: `missing_lo` (page lacked any learningObjectives JSON-LD), `gate_block` (page violated per-week LO contract or another critical gate), `outline_filter` (page excluded by the `--outline-only` filter — intentional pruning, not a quality failure). The `internal_drop_reason_missing` bucket fires when the silent-gaming check trips.
